what: How many children were enrolled in each Lunenburg school, by grade, on October 1, 2004?
why: `report-enrollment-mcas` holds an enrollment-by-school-and-grade table from the 2010 annual town report (p34). The 2004 annual town report prints none: its Textract text was searched for enrollment, enrolment, October 1 and students across all 112 pages. The hits are prose: p32 gives Monty Tech's October 1, 2004 enrollment by member town (Lunenburg 59), and p45 gives the Elementary and Primary Schools a `combined enrollment of six hundred thirty students`. No count by school and grade for the district. — closes: DESE's October 1, 2004 enrollment report for Lunenburg by school and grade (SIMS), or the district's own October 1 report for 2004-05.

what: How many weighing and measuring devices did the Sealer test, seal, adjust or condemn in 2004, and what fee was charged for each class?
why: `report-weights-measures` holds the Sealer's device counts and per-device fees from the 2010 report (p24-25). The 2004 report prints no table: Textract text searched for weights, sealer and sealed. The Inspector's report (PDF p22) gives only two figures in prose -- `The fiscal budget was $2,310` and `were charged $3,885 in fees` -- and its last sentence stops at `All of the` at the foot of the page; PDF p23 was opened by eye and begins a different paragraph, so the device list is not printed, not merely unread. — closes: the Inspector of Weights & Measures' annual report to the Division of Standards for 2004 (device counts by class).

what: What were the town's non-union grade-and-step hourly rates and job classifications in 2004?
why: `salary-schedule` and `report-classification-plan` hold Schedule A (grade by step) and the classification plan from the 2010 report (p85-86). The 2004 report prints neither: Textract text searched for salary schedule, point value, classification (hits only the accountant's `SUMMARY & CLASSIFICATION OF ACCOUNTS` p55-60 and p99) and schedule a (p27, 76, 77, 100, all unrelated). The only reference is ATM 2004 Article 3 (p95), which names the `Salary Administration Plan of the Town of Lunenburg voted May 2003` and was PASSED OVER. — closes: the Salary Administration Plan as voted at the May 2003 Annual Town Meeting, with its Schedule A.

what: How much of Lunenburg's debt at 30 June 2004 sat inside the debt limit, and how much outside it?
why: `outstanding-debt` reads this from the outstanding-debt summary the FY2011-FY2025 reports print. The 2004 report prints its bonded indebtedness issue by issue (PDF p75) and a repayment schedule (p76-77) with no summary by purpose and no debt-limit split: Textract text searched for debt limit, outstanding debt and long-term indebtedness returned nothing, and long term debt only the balance-sheet lines on p52. The repayment schedule does print each municipal-purpose issue's exempt share (`PRINCIPAL (82% EXEMPT)`, `(69% EXEMPT)`), which is not the same split. — closes: the Town's FY2004 Statement of Indebtedness as filed with the Division of Local Services.
